title: Surgery without postoperative adjuvant therapy for dissecting cellulitis of the scalp: a retrospective study of a selected cohort.
snippet: Evidence regarding the efficacy of surgery without postoperative adjuvant therapy (SWPAT) for dissecting cellulitis of the scalp (DCS) remains limited, and objective biomarkers predicting postoperative outcomes are lacking.
